Youth are the future of innovation for our climate and oceans. By supporting our youth as leaders of digital transformation and climate action, we can strengthen our communities at their foundations and build the next generation of leaders and innovators.

There are four thematic areas: food and agriculture ,energy, education and urban sustainability. Apply here by March 31st, and please share with your communities 👉https://lnkd.in/dgC6nHia
 
Youth4Climate brings together existing and new online and offline resources, tools, capacities, partnerships, networks, and movements by and for youth, with a strong focus on implementation, for more sustained impact on climate on the ground.
